title: SDP cryptex inspector
blurb: Generates real createOffer() SDP across rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy, bundlePolicy, and audio/video/data-channel m-sections to inspect a=cryptex placement and list every protected a=extmap RTP header extension.
question: Where does a=cryptex appear in real WebRTC offers across bundle policies and media mixes, and does it cover every RTP m= section while excluding SCTP data channels?
result: Verified in Chrome 153 headless: with --enable-blink-features=RtcRtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy, offers emit one session-level a=cryptex covering 2/2 RTP sections (audio and video) and 0 data-channel sections; unflagged offers emit no a=cryptex. The 'disable' offer path could not execute on Chrome 153 and awaits Chrome 160+.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 (unflagged and --enable-blink-features=RtcRtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy); not verified in Chrome 160

friction.summary: Chromium emits a=cryptex at the SDP session level rather than repeating it inside each m= section
friction.repro: Create an offer with audio and video transceivers in flagged Chrome 153 and split offer.sdp by m= sections; a=cryptex appears once in section 0 (session level) rather than inside m=audio and m=video.
friction.workaround: Check both the session-level SDP header and individual RTP m= sections when inspecting whether cryptex is offered or negotiated.
